title: YouTube Upload Frequency & Growth Correlation Study
sourceTitle: How Often Should You Upload to YouTube (Data Study)
sampleDescription: 10,210,278 YouTube channels with at least 1,000 subscribers tracking uploads between April 2025 and March 2026
limitations: Association does not equal causation: creators uploading 12+ times/month often possess higher production budgets, full-time staff, and established workflow momentum
Does not account for video length or production complexity differences (Shorts vs 40-minute documentaries)
